name: Learn a skill
goalText: Learn enough Spanish conversation to handle a ten-minute coffee chat in three months.

interviewOutputArtifact.goalSummary: Build beginner Spanish conversation confidence for a ten-minute coffee chat.
interviewOutputArtifact.coreWhy: The user wants to connect with Spanish-speaking neighbors and feel less stuck when speaking.
interviewOutputArtifact.successDefinition: A ten-minute coffee chat is completed with prepared topics, follow-up questions, and a short reflection.
interviewOutputArtifact.currentStage: The user knows scattered vocabulary but freezes during live conversation.
blockers: Too many app lessons without real conversation
interviewOutputArtifact.compactSourceSummary: The user wants practical Spanish speaking practice for a real coffee chat, not grammar perfection.

transcript.content: I want to learn Spanish but I freeze when I try to speak.
What would prove the skill is working in real life?
A ten-minute coffee chat where I can ask follow-up questions and not switch back to English immediately.
